title: Path-probability gradients for optimizing force fields against dynamical observables
abstract: arXiv:2611.32851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning force fields inherit the errors of the electronic-structure methods used to generate their training data, and refining them against experimental measurements provides a direct route beyond this limit. However, such refinement remains difficult for dynamical observables because differentiating chaotic molecular trajectories yields unstable gradients. Here, we introduce PathGrad, which differentiates Langevin path probabilities instead of the trajectories themselves. The resulting gradient estimator is accumulated on the fly from thermal noise and force derivatives, and its variance remains stable as the trajectory length increases. We validated the gradient estimator against finite-difference calculations and used it to fine-tune molten-copper and water potentials against experimental diffusion coefficients together with structural constraints. translated_title: 基于路径概率梯度针对动力学观测量优化力场
translated_abstract: 机器学习力场继承了用于生成其训练数据的电子结构方法的误差，而利用实验测量数据对其进行精修提供了一条突破这一限制的直接途径。然而，对于动力学观测量而言，这种精修仍然十分困难，因为对混沌的分子轨迹进行微分会产生不稳定的梯度。在此，我们提出了PathGrad方法，它对朗之万路径概率而非轨迹本身进行微分。由此得到的梯度估计器可以从热噪声和力导数中即时累积，并且其方差随着轨迹长度的增加保持稳定。我们通过有限差分计算验证了该梯度估计器，并利用它结合实验扩散系数以及结构约束，对熔融铜和水的势能模型进行了微调。对于水，我们联合优化了扩散系数和氧-氧径向分布函数。
tldr: 提出PathGrad方法，通过对朗之万路径概率而非混沌分子轨迹求导，获得方差稳定的梯度估计器，从而能够直接利用实验动力学观测量（如扩散系数）对机器学习力场进行微调。
en_tdlr: PathGrad differentiates Langevin path probabilities instead of chaotic molecular trajectories, yielding a variance-stable gradient estimator that enables direct fine-tuning of machine learning force fields against experimental dynamical observables such as diffusion coefficients.
